The '''Skakoans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] distinguished by their dependence on a [[Pressure suit/Legends|bulky pressurized suit]] to survive away from their homeworld, [[Skako/Legends|Skako]]. A highly xenophobic people, the Skakoans rarely departed their homeworld unless need drove them.

==Biology and appearance==
Native to the high-pressure [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Skako/Legends|Skako]], the Skakoans breathed a [[Methane/Legends|methane]]-based air supply. Resembling gaunt [[Human/Legends|Humans]], Skakoans had grey-white skin which hung in folds over their skeletons, lacked hair and had sunken, beady eyes. Thin nasal slits allowed them to detect odor, while a thin, lipless mouth allowed them to speak. Because Skakoans did not ingest solid food, they lacked teeth in their gaping mouths. An average Skakoan maintained a life-span of 90-110 years. Due to the nature of their homeworld's above-average pressure, traveling offworld meant wearing a specialized [[Pressure suit/Legends|protective suit]] which maintained internal pressure and fed methane through special piping. Fear of decompression or rupturing of their suits kept most Skakoans on their world; only those driven by a very compelling motive were ever seen far from Skako.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Society and culture==
Because outsiders rarely visited Skako, few saw the species without their pressurized suits. This caused many non-Skakoans to believe the race was emotionless and machine-like. In spite of the misconception, the Skakoans were extremely emotional. Skakoan society harbored a strong xenophobia for all non-Skakoans. As a society, Skakoans were severe and self-centered, focused on self-preservation above all else. They developed a deep logic which allowed them to solve nearly any problem and driving their society towards the mathematical, scientific and technological professions. Restricting construction of their pressure suits to Skako due to their mistrust of others, visitors were forced to don their own suits when landing on the world.<ref name="NEGAS" />

A deeply spiritual people, the Skakoans had developed a [[Skakoan religion|highly evolved religion]] based on the ''[[Book of the Boolmide]]''. Led by [[Elders (Skakoan)|the Elders]] of the [[Power Mounds of the Elders|Power Mounds]], the religion was only found on Skako and centered around an omniscient mythic beast known as the [[Albino Cyclops]].<ref name="WTAC">{{StoryCite|story=Wat Tambor and the Quest for the Sacred Eye of the Albino Cyclops|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>

==History==
Native to the planet [[Skako/Legends|Skako]], the Skakoans were discovered during the blazing of the [[Brentaal–Denon Route]] of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] before the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Establishing a major [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] comparable in terms of population and scale to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet-wide city lacked the Republic capital's charm and aesthetics.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> However, Skako preserved vast tracts of its original ecosystem, unlike other ecumenopolis worlds. While Skakoans tended to stay out of galactic affairs, war was on their doorstep during the [[Second Alsakan Conflict]] which lasted from [[16,200 BBY]] until [[15,400 BBY]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Attaining membership in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], the Skakoans also had a leading interest within the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] by the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] which plagued the Republic in its final days. The Skakoan representative [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] led the Techno Union away from the Republic and to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], for which Skako was expelled from the Republic. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted, Skako was placed under the watchful eye of the [[First Army|1st Sector Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. After Skako fell to the Republic and [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] Tambor was [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|murdered]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] with the rest of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], the Confederacy collapsed and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] replaced the Republic. Heralding a new era of [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]], the Empire crushed the Techno Union and persecuted the Skakoans for their involvement in the war. Retreating to Skako to resume their isolationist stance, the Skakoans avoided the destruction of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] by remaining distant from both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. By [[127 ABY]], Skako had been enveloped by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Skakoans in the galaxy==
[[File:Kul_Teska.jpg|thumb|right|225px|[[Kul Teska]], a Skakoan cyborg with enhanced pressure suit.]]

A highly xenophobic species, the Skakoans rarely left their homeworld for fear of rupturing their pressure suits or suffocating in a non-methane atmosphere. Those Skakoans seen abroad were almost always driven by some important need to have thought it best to leave their home, and return was always in mind. The Skakoans were relatively unknown in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], except for their control over the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].<ref name="NEGAS" />  No Skakoan members were ever recorded to have been in either the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] or the [[Order of the Sith Lords]].

[[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the Techno Union, was a Skakoan. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tambor pledged the support of the Techno Union to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and aided militarily in the conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]; supporting the war effort by supplying [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and weapons. Skakoan control of the Techno Union came to an end with the death of Tambor on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Other members of the species included [[Clongor]], Chief among the [[Elders (Skakoan)|Elders]] and leader of the Skakoan religion during the Clone Wars;<ref name="WTAC" /> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Hrym Mawarr]], [[Kul Teska]], a [[Cyborg/Legends|cybernetically-enhanced]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[General/Legends|general]] during the Clone Wars,<ref name="CWRH">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref> and [[Zona Dreon]].<ref name="NEGAS" />
